content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IGIMS Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IGIMS Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report on the specified date for the interview. There is no separate application deadline mentioned.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Medical qualification included in schedule I & II of the NMC Act, along with an NMC recognized P.G. qualification of MD/MS Ophthalmology.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST, EBC/BC, and female candidates as per State Government rules.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies for the Senior Resident post at IGIMS Patna.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the IGIMS Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000 for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 250 for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident role?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on a Walk-in Interview, which includes the presentation of thesis and publications.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates bring for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their thesis, publication (in pen-drive), application form, and copies of all supportive certificates/documents, along with original certificates for verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The job type is mentioned as Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Walk-in Interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences Patna (IGIMS), Patna, Bihar.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Resident post will be as per the Institute Rules.
